scripts.clean: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans && docker system prune -f
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean
scripts.clean:backend: cd backend && rm -fr dist node_modules && cd ..
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm ci && cd ../backend && npm ci && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.prisma:generate: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma generate'
scripts.prisma:migrate: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.prisma:push: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma db push'
scripts.prisma:baseline: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 20240101000000_init'
scripts.prisma:init: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma db push --force-reset && npx prisma generate'
scripts.prisma:build: docker exec meal-ticket-backend sh -c 'npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node /app/prisma/seed.js'
scripts.nuke: npm run clean:all && npm run install:all && npm run up && npm run prisma:build
scripts.nuke:all: docker system prune -a -f && npm run clean:backend && npm run install:all && npm run up && npm run prisma:build && npm run prisma:seed
